name: Ormosbánya (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of black and yellow triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ormosbánya (a yellow and black shield with a wing and crossed hammers) above the name ORMOSBÁNYA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of black and yellow triangles
